title: Rooms and narrow spaces take their skylight from the world round them
summary: Rooms, wall feet, woods and gaps between houses lose skylight; reflections indoors lose the sky; fires glow on their surroundings; open ground is unchanged.
stage: --scenario=breach --seed=3 --fixed-fps 30. Midday room: --mood=day --focus=0,-30 --zoom=8 --pitch=-62 at 5 s; the same in the rain: --mood=rain. Golden-hour room: --mood=golden --focus=0,-30 --zoom=12 --pitch=-40 --cam-yaw=0.5 at 5 s. Leaks (review): FL_DEBUG_PROBES_AB=leak FL_DEBUG_PROBES_VIEW=4, midday room. --scenario=fire --seed=3: wood edge --mood=day --focus=-16,-27 --zoom=20 --pitch=-55, time frozen at 5 s (FL_DEBUG_PROBES_AB=cycle FL_DEBUG_PROBES_FREEZE=<dir> FL_DEBUG_PROBES_FREEZE_AT=5); night fires --mood=night --focus=-6,-22 --zoom=14 --pitch=-50 at 8 s. Between houses (review): --mood=golden --focus=7,-31 --zoom=12 --pitch=-10 at 12 s. Destruction: --mood=day --focus=12,-31 --zoom=14 --pitch=-50 --blast-at=14,-29,3,6, 60 frames every 0.1 s.
rationale: Each sheet is cropped tight on where probes matter. OFF and ON are adjacent frames (1/30 s apart) of one probes-on run that cycles the probes off, on, their term and the bent normal three frames each (FL_DEBUG_PROBES_AB=cycle), so smoke and men barely move between them; the probe term comes from the same run. The difference panel is ON minus OFF x4 around mid grey. The flicker clip alternates OFF and ON; the destruction clip pairs the game with the probe term from a second identical fixed-fps run (FL_DEBUG_PROBES_VIEW=1).

capture.provenance: Recaptured off-screen from this branch (Forward+, RTX 3090, High preset) with the commands in stage; panels are consecutive frames of one fixed-fps run, so they share camera, units and smoke.
capture.comparison: Player sheets: top left probes off, bottom left on, top right the probe term (sky share on grey, bounce amplified), bottom right ON minus OFF x4 on mid grey. Review sheets (PR only) show the bent normal instead of the difference. Flicker: off and on alternate each second on one frame. Destruction: the game and the probe term from two identical fixed-fps runs.
capture.limits: Measured (linear light): the midday room falls to 0.75 of its brightness; its shade is 0.22 of the sunlit floor. In the rain the wet floor indoors falls to 0.29 as the sky leaves its reflection. Under the crowns the probes' sky term is 0.5-0.75 of open ground; in final pixels the ground under and round the crowns is about 19% darker, and greener (green to red 0.95 to 1.10, as the crowns' share of the lost skylight comes back through the leaves), the men under them 20% dimmer; open ground changes under 5%. Round the night fires the ground is up to half as bright again. Light-leak fix: visible on wall tops, sills and door leaves; room floors were already held at the 30% skylight floor. Fast debris and flames move between the two frames and speckle the difference. Trenches are narrower than the 2 m grid and are not shown. The destruction clip predates this pass. The Compatibility renderer (browser) gets the skylight shading, reflections and fire glow but not the indoor sun cut.

source_ref: dines/probe-grid-gi-0571ca: the specular-occlusion, canopy, leak and fire-glow pass after 0b2ac192.
